description: With Pararius, everyone can easily find the right home. Open the site or app and search the Netherlands' largest private-sector housing offering in just a few seconds. Type a city, neighbourhood or postcode to discover properties, use filters to refine listings by price, surface area, number of rooms or furnishing, set alerts to be the first to know about new homes and contact the agent directly. An intuitive platform to use, even without experience in the Dutch rental market. Search for the home that fits you, from studios and apartments in Amsterdam to family houses in Apeldoorn.

defaultPrompt: Welke appartementen kan ik huren in Amsterdam tot 2.500 euro per maand?
